candidates.title: SeqMoE: Toward Full-Load Performance via Predictive and Graph-Compatible MoE Offloading
candidates.reason: September MoE offloading work uses sequence-model activation prediction and graph-compatible scheduling to approach full-load performance; strong fit to expert prefetch/offload lineage.

candidates.title: Who Should Own the Expert Cache? Kernel-Managed Tiering for Trillion-Parameter MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Large-scale study of OS page cache vs user-space expert caches on up to 1.45TB expert pools; directly informs expert-cache ownership/tiering design.

candidates.title: DraftExpert: Expansion-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for End-Device MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Combines speculative decoding with expert offload-aware expansion control and target-expert prefetching across CPU-GPU and Flash-NPU paths.

candidates.title: APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching for Memory-Efficient Edge MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Learned confidence-based expert prefetching for edge MoE inference; relevant to predictive loading under constrained off-chip memory.
